from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional

class CompanyFinancialReport(BaseModel):
    """One company's financial data from a single 2025 Q1 report."""
    company_name: Optional[str] = Field(description="Name of the company")
    stock_code: Optional[str] = Field(description="Stock security code")
    period: str = Field(description="Reporting period, e.g., '2025-Q1'")
    currency: str = Field(description="Currency unit of the figures")
    operating_revenue: float = Field(description="Operating revenue amount")
    net_profit_attributable_to_shareholders: float = Field(description="Net profit attributable to shareholders")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    reports: List[CompanyFinancialReport]
